content: {"reasoning":"The CO-97 bundling denial remains after a medical-necessity appeal, so resubmission would not correct the adjudication and patient billing would improperly shift a contractual denial. Authorization rework is inapplicable because this CPT does not require authorization and retroactive authorization is unavailable. Because the payer offers peer-to-peer review and a denial is on file, clinician review is the remaining payer path that can properly challenge the bundling decision.","action":"request_peer_to_peer"}
